audit_items.proof_trace: When total_supply == 0, exchange_rate() returns exactly 1.0 (L93-94), so mint_amount = int_div(collateral, 1.0) = collateral_amount; the assertion at L157 ensures collateral_amount > 0, guaranteeing ctoken_minted > 0. Post-deposit exchange rate = cash/total_supply = X/X = 1.0. The classic inflation attack requires donating tokens directly to the reserve without minting ctokens, but deposit_underlying() is a private function inaccessible from outside the module, and all deposit paths atomically mint ctokens; overpayment via repay_amount routes excess to cash_reserve (cancelling the cash increase), so no external donation vector exists.
